tales.title: ექო: დაცემა, რომელიც არ ყოფილა — Echo: The Fall That Was Not

beats.narration: You step into a memory that is not real. A ქაჯი has woven an Echo of Didgori in which the line broke, the wondrous victory never came, and Georgia was erased that morning in 1121. The fiction is plain: this is a what-if, a corruption, the silence imagining a defeat. Witness the lie, and do not mistake it for the truth you already kept.

The false memory is seductive in its despair — it whispers that the real victory was luck, that the nation was always doomed, that there is no point in the standing. This is how an Echo works: it offers you the comfort of the worst. Witness the temptation to believe defeat, the sweetest poison the Unremembering pours.

Because this is an Echo and not the sacred true tale, the gloves come off: the Kaji here is stronger, the fight harder, the corruption able to push back as the canon never would. Ward against it with everything — for here you are not protecting a fragile real moment, you are tearing down a lie that wears its face. Break the false field.

As the Kaji fails, the false defeat unravels and the real morning reasserts itself — ძლევაჲ საკვირველი, the wondrous victory, exactly as it was. Restore the truth over the lie. An Echo defeated does not change history; it strengthens the memory of what really happened by contrast with what the dark wished had.

The corrupted memory dissolves like mist, and the true Didgori stands brighter for having been falsely challenged. You have done a different kind of keeping here — not the holding of a real moment, but the dispelling of a beautiful lie about it. The Echo fades. The truth remains, and is harder now to shake.
